newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Huge cocaine haul reported in Colombian capital.
newsitem.headline: Huge cocaine haul reported in Colombian capital.

text.p: Police seized more than 1,500 pounds (681 kg) of cocaine in a raid on a house in a working-class district of Bogota on Friday, authorities said.

Deputy National Police Chief Gen. Luis Enrique Montenegro said no arrests were made in the raid but authorities were combing the San Antonio neighbourhood on the south side of the capital in search of possible suspects.

The drug, described as of top quality, was smuggled into the capital overland from the southern provinces of Caqueta or Putumayo, Montenegro told Reuters. He said it was believed to have been destined for the Pacific port of Tumaco where it would have been put aboard a ship bound for Mexico and ultimately transported to the United States.
The drug haul brought the total of refined cocaine seized in Colombia this year to more than 25 tonnes, authorities said.
